summary: Evil HEROes with the Dark Fusion cards and generic staples; the Elemental HERO materials some old Evil HERO Fusions name are left out, along with the Fusions that need them. The 2025 wave leads. Evil Assault discards a card to fetch or summon a small Evil HERO. Evil HERO Infernal Rider searches Dark Fusion and later sets Super Polymerization from the Deck. Evil HERO Dead-End Prison summons itself next to a Dark Fusion monster and stands in for one named material, which turns Evil HERO Inferno Wing - Backfire into a Fusion this list can make. Evil HERO Malicious Bane is still the boss: it can't be destroyed and wipes every weaker monster. Both Evil HERO pages open this list.
